american-sign-museum.mobility.1: The entire collection resides on one floor that’s easy to navigate. The Museum has two wheelchairs available for visitor use on a first-come-first-serve basis.
american-sign-museum.chronic.1: There are chairs throughout the Museum as well.
american-sign-museum.sensory.1: Braille book tours and printed copies of the highlights are available in English, Spanish, Arabic, Nepali, German, French, and Chinese in the tour stand near the Admissions desk.
The on-line audio tour is available in English, Spanish, Arabic, Nepali, German, French, and Chinese and can be accessed using the QR code by the ramp.
american-sign-museum.sensory.2: Guests who may have difficulty with blinking or flashing lights will need to use discretion.
american-sign-museum.mobility.2: Handicapped parking spaces are along the side of the building, closer to our side lobby entrance.
american-sign-museum.cognitive.1: We recommend at least 60-90 minutes for your visit.
american-sign-museum.chronic.2: For the safety of the collection, food and drinks are not permitted in the exhibition areas.
everybodys-treehouse-mt-airy-forest.chro: Area 10 (across from Everybody’s Treehouse) and Area 13 (in the middle of Cindee Walsh Circle ) are both first come first serve shelters available for public use, restrooms are available at both shelters.
Mt. Airy Forest Area 10 Restrooms: open 6 a.m. – 10 p.m.
everybodys-treehouse-mt-airy-forest.cogn: Cincinnati Parks is committed to providing a quality experience at all our parks and facilities by providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request. To request an accommodation fill out a Reasonable Accommodation Request Form linked here.
mariemont-players-walton-creek-theater.m: Please note that space for walkers and rollators is limited, and these items may need to be stored in a designated closet inside the auditorium.
mariemont-players-walton-creek-theater.s: Mariemont Players is equipped with a Hearing Loop (T-Coil) system, which transmits crystal-clear audio directly to compatible hearing aids and cochlear implants switched to the "T" or "T-Coil" setting.
For patrons without a T-coil-enabled device, loop receiver headsets are also available free of charge at the box office prior to showtime.
mariemont-players-walton-creek-theater.m: Mariemont Players, Inc. does have a small but mighty parking lot onsite. For shows that are sold out, the parking lot can fill up, so we do encourage car pooling if possible.
